mapper.sql: select message_id, from_user_id, to_user_id, group_id, content, message_type, status, create_time, is_read, extra, source, is_revoked, revoke_time from im_message
mapper.select: where ((from_user_id = #{userId1} and to_user_id = #{userId2}) or (from_user_id = #{userId2} and to_user_id = #{userId1})) and group_id is null order by create_time desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select count(*) from im_message where to_user_id = #{userId} and is_read = 0
select count(*) from im_message where to_user_id = #{userId} and from_user_id = #{targetUserId} and is_read = 0
select count(*) from im_message where group_id = #{groupId} and create_time > #{joinTime} and is_read = 0
